usage: 墨西哥 (mak6 sai1 go1) is used as a proper noun to refer to the country Mexico.
When talking about nationalities, 墨西哥 can be combined with 人 (jan4) to mean Mexican person (墨西哥人 mak6 sai1 go1 jan4).
It functions as a subject or object in sentences when discussing places or origins.
You can use 墨西哥 when mentioning travel destinations, cultural aspects, or food related to Mexico.
墨西哥 is often paired with verbs like 去 (heoi3 - to go) or 來 (loi4 - to come) when discussing movement to or from the country.

examples.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 heoi3 mak6 sai1 go1 leoi5 hang4.
examples.meaning: I want to travel to Mexico.

examples.sentence: 呢度有好多墨西哥餐廳。
examples.jyutping: ni1 dou6 jau5 hou2 do1 mak6 sai1 go1 caan1 teng1.
examples.meaning: There are many Mexican restaurants here.
